user_authorization.immediate_context: Antwort auf die Vorlage: WS-HC-20260918-01 einschließlich unverändertem Review-Transfer nach erfolgreicher Konsumprüfung, zwei Harness-Korrekturen und Vorbereitung der Reviewer-Umgebung; ohne Merge, Produkt- oder Browserarbeit.
user_authorization.interpretation: Freigabe genau dieses begrenzten Folgeumfangs in der bereits gewählten Codex-Umgebung.
user_authorization.limitation: Keine erweiterte wörtliche Nutzererklärung oder unabhängige Plattformauthentifizierung behauptet. Kein Merge oder neuer unabhängiger Review durch diese Freigabe.

prior_execution_reference.relationship: Vorheriger Lauf beendet; neuer Record autorisiert nur diese Fortsetzung. Alter Record bleibt unverändert.

source_return_package.treatment: Alle acht Archivdateien bytegleich unter return/ erhalten; eigenes altes Manifest bleibt unverändert.

repository_binding.own_new_commits: Fast-forward descendants of the bound run start on the same branch; record expected predecessor before each subsequent write/push. No bypass for unknown intervening work.
repository_binding.history_rule: Run start 9b6dd621... und kumulativer Review-/Historybeginn 4ba2c473... bleiben getrennt; neuer Run darf unakzeptierten alten Delta nicht aus dem Prüfbereich entfernen.

before_transfer: Use pinned CPython 3.14.4 and actual exact Git objects in isolated scratch.
Read exact original subject, V2 contract, canonical validator and all 18 evidence files.
Verify evidence hashes, subject/type/authority/provenance/result locator and external user-supplied provenance.
Execute original request/schema-preflight/validate-result against the bound old subject before transfer; record commands, exits and scope.
Do not modify payload or consumer merely to make this transfer pass.
review_transport_contract.after_transfer: Verify byte identity in Git; preserve every original field and whitespace. Separate actual transfer and consumption record.

findings_scope.action: Versionenbewusste Korrektur, keine rückwirkende V2-Syntaxpflicht für V1.
Reviewer-Umgebung vorbereiten; Closure erst durch tatsächlichen neuen unabhängigen Ablauf.
Status im neuen Rücklauf für begrenzten POSIX/Linux-Scope erhalten; altes Reviewpayload mit OPEN unverändert lassen; keine unnötige Writer-Neuentwicklung.

protected_truth: Technical Foundation r6 and READY binding
T01–T05-R2 including all CPU limits and nonblocking soft targets
All existing foundation/inputs and foundation/sources originals
All historical result bytes and historical commit identities
contract_change_policy: Necessary prospective version/contract/consumer clarifications are allowed with compatibility tests. No in-place rewrite of historical commits/results and no gate weakening or ID/SHA exemption.

environment.permitted_runtime_setup: Existing runtime preferred; isolated local official-source provisioning without new cost/provider/admin/system mutation only.
environment.git_transport: Read-only clone/fetch of approved public repositories; no presumed access and no manual reconstruction as execution substitute.
environment.models_and_reasoning: Available sufficient configuration in the existing authorized environment only; no provider router or new billing/data boundary.

requirements: Actual pinned checks/tests/build/history/contract-version compatibility with exact new-head CI.
Bound current subject/evidence and cumulative baseline plus run baseline.
Reviewer execution context provided and own setup checks honestly classified.
Report new head/tree, PR, actual changed scope, commands/exits/CI, open findings, limitations and exact locators.
end_state.environment_failure: Report ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED and exact missing capabilities; do not claim all readiness requirements satisfied.

effect: Execution context only, not Product Truth, review verdict, integration permission or assertion of completed work.
